title: Strangled Red - Knocker Reskin
description: A texture pack that converts Ma_Do's The Knocker into Steven, the main antagonist of the Strangled Red pokémon creepypasta
body:
Strangled Red Knocker is a texture pack that converts Ma_Do's The Knocker into the Steven, the main antagonist in the Pokemon creepypasta called "Stranged Red" Creepypasta inspiration: [https://creepypasta.fandom.com/wiki/Strangled_Red](https://creepypasta.fandom.com/wiki/Strangled_Red) The Knocker mod (Required): [https://modrinth.com/mod/the-knocker](https://modrinth.com/mod/the-knocker) Perfect for use in Pokemon horror modpacks that use Cobblemon or Pixelmon ![Red Knocker Strangled Red Creepypasta Dweller Horror Spooky Creepy](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9bf59278d7e9582f463e731badc04f6d319bf3af_0.webp)
### Check out my other related projects: LULLABY Hypno Goatman: [Link to mod page](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/lullaby-goatman)
HorrorMon Creepypasta forms: [Link to mod page](https://modrinth.com/datapack/horrormon-horror-forms)
